intent.text: Demonstrate MC-MALFORMED-ACCEPTANCE detection: an acceptance item with neither a usable verifier nor a review.

commitment: The parser accepts the decision but emits MC-MALFORMED-ACCEPTANCE for the item whose result field is not in the result enum.

outcomes.statement: malformed acceptance is detected and reported

assumptions.consequence_if_false: Malformed results silently drop the item

obligations.claim: An acceptance item must name a check: an item with no verifier and no review is malformed.

counterexample: An acceptance item with a non-enum result value is silently dropped without surface emission.
antithesis: This conformance fixture asserts the MC-MALFORMED-ACCEPTANCE diagnostic fires when an acceptance item's result value is not in the result enum. The v3 dialectic antithesis slot is unrelated to that assertion; the author considered and rejected the counter-position that a result-enum demo need not carry dialectic content because its purpose is a parser diagnostic, not a dialectic test. The kernel requires antithesis for mode >= standard regardless of fixture intent, so the fixture carries a documentary antithesis string naming the position considered and rejected.
